episodes.title: Annie Dawid Co hosts On the Air with Florenza
episodes.description:
What happens when paradise becomes a prison—and the promise of a better world turns into an unimaginable nightmare?

Jonestown. November 18, 1978. More than 900 lives lost in one of history’s most devastating tragedies. But behind the headlines were real people with dreams, hopes, and stories worth telling.

On this episode of On the Air with Florenza, I sit down with award-winning author Annie Dawid to discuss her powerful novel, Paradise Undone: A Novel of Jonestown. Through a haunting blend of historical fact and fiction, Annie explores the lives caught in Jim Jones’s web of manipulation, the seductive promise of belonging, and the devastating consequences of misplaced faith.

This isn't simply a story about how paradise was lost. It's about the people who believed they had found it.

🎧 Listen. Read. Ponder.
